rendered: The variant that retained the most capacity is NFA-A: ≈80% capacity retention after 100 cycles at C/3[1], compared with NFA 811 (≈70%)[2]. Its composition is LiNi0.8Fe0.05Al0.15O2[3], so its aluminium content is 15% Al[4] and its iron content is 5% lron NFA-A[5]. The c lattice parameter that Table 1[6] gives for the row labelled Al-rich NFA, the aluminium-rich composition that is NFA-A, is 14.2232(4)[7].
